exercises.q: What does при- add in прийти́?
exercises.why: Wiktionary lists прийти́ under this meaning of при-. Source: Wiktionary, «при-» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/при-#Russian).
**приду** — прийти́ (perfective): to come (to), to arrive (at). Wiktionary: при- + -йти́.
exercises.context: Which prefix? The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **приду** — прийти́ (perfective): to come (to), to arrive (at). Wiktionary: при- + -йти́.

exercises.q: What does у- add in увезти́?
options: moving away from, leaving a place by the action of the base verb
keeping in the state the base verb names
making the object as many times bigger as the base numeral says
destroying or using up the object by the action of the base verb
exercises.why: The Russian Wiktionary lists увезти́ under this meaning of у-. Source: Russian Wiktionary, «у-», meaning 1 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/у-).

exercises.q: What does у- add in угна́ть?
options: completing the action of the base verb, bringing it to a result or to exhaustive fullness
making the object as many times bigger as the base numeral says
moving away from, leaving a place by the action of the base verb
keeping in the state the base verb names
exercises.why: The Russian Wiktionary lists угна́ть under this meaning of у-. Source: Russian Wiktionary, «у-», meaning 1 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/у-).

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to come (to), to arrive (at) (place, conclusion, state of abandonment, anger, insanity)
to take away, to carry away (by vehicle)
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: прийти́ — to come (to), to arrive (at); прилете́ть — to fly (here), to arrive (by flying); приходи́ть — to come (to), to arrive (at) (place, conclusion, state of abandonment, anger, insanity); увезти́ — to take away, to carry away (by vehicle).
**угнал** — угна́ть (perfective): to steal anything that can move by itself (vehicle, vessel, cattle, etc). Wiktionary: у- + гнать.
exercises.context: Which prefix? The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **угнали** — угна́ть (perfective): to steal anything that can move by itself (vehicle, vessel, cattle, etc). Wiktionary: у- + гнать.

exercises.q: What does у- add in уйти́?
options: keeping in the state the base verb names
destroying or using up the object by the action of the base verb
covering the object completely with something by the action of the base verb
moving away from, leaving a place by the action of the base verb
exercises.why: The Russian Wiktionary lists уйти́ under this meaning of у-. Source: Russian Wiktionary, «у-», meaning 1 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/у-).
